question: For each port that is DOWN and also has admin_state_up = 1 with at least one security group binding, list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, network ID, MAC address, device owner, allocated IP address, the row number within its network (ordered by port ID), the number of security group bindings, the total number of DNS records, and the DNS-records-per-security-group-binding ratio rounded to 2 decimals.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_ports AS (
    SELECT p.id AS port_id
    FROM ports p
    WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
      AND p.admin_state_up = 1
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM securitygroupportbindings sgpb
          WHERE sgpb.port_id = p.id
      )
),
port_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS port_id,
        p.tenant_id,
        p.name AS port_name,
        p.network_id,
        p.mac_address,
        p.device_owner,
        ia.ip_address AS allocated_ip_address,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.network_id ORDER BY p.id) AS row_number_in_network,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securitygroupportbindings sgpb WHERE sgpb.port_id = p.id) AS security_group_binding_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portdnses pd WHERE pd.port_id = p.id) AS dns_record_count
    FROM ports p
    INNER JOIN eligible_ports ep ON ep.port_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
)
SELECT
    pm.port_id,
    pm.tenant_id,
    pm.port_name,
    pm.network_id,
    pm.mac_address,
    pm.device_owner,
    pm.allocated_ip_address,
    pm.row_number_in_network,
    pm.security_group_binding_count,
    pm.dns_record_count,
    ROUND(pm.dns_record_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(pm.security_group_binding_count, 0), 2) AS dns_per_sgb_ratio
FROM port_metrics pm
ORDER BY pm.network_id, pm.port_id
